title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description: Can you guess which egg has the dragon inside? Watch to find out! 🐉🔥 Comment your guess below! #Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Kidify #FunForKids

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a dragon — but which one?
scenes.visual_prompt: three colorful Easter eggs on table

scenes.narration: Is it the red egg, the blue egg, or the golden egg? Pick one fast!
The countdown is on — three, two, one!
The red egg cracks open and... it's a rubber duck! Quack quack!
The blue egg cracks open and... it's a tiny sneezing hamster! Bless you!
That means the golden egg is the one! It cracks open — and out comes the dragon!
Did you get it right? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
